scoring_justification: Checker refits universal EOS from agent's raw isotherm data points and compares resulting parameters to paper gold; also computes pressure consistency at hidden reduced volumes using refit parameters. T1 is feasible because the raw P-X pairs are submitted by the agent and can be refit by lightweight curve_fit.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold EOS parameters (B0, eta, beta, xi, delta) for Cu,Ta,Mo,Pt,Au from the paper's Table II, used for parameter comparison and to compute gold pressures at hidden volumes.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the published paper's table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Extracted from a verifiable, published reference; not synthetic or guessed.

outputs.description: Shock‑reduced 300 K isotherm data points for Cu, Ta, Mo, Pt, Au. The checker refits the universal EOS from these points and computes pressure consistency at hidden reduced volumes.
Fitted universal EOS parameters (B₀, η, β, ξ, δ) for each metal. The checker compares these to the hidden gold values with predefined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform all process steps (LAPW and MFP) to produce the full pipeline output. The D-u coefficients are provided in the instruction as a table. No empirical Grüneisen parameters or ad hoc heat-capacity assumptions are needed.

steps.description: Refit universal EOS from agent's raw data points; compare resulting parameters to paper gold and compute pressure consistency at hidden reduced volumes (0.75, 0.85, 0.95).
Compare agent's fitted EOS parameters directly to the hidden paper gold values.
